reading_issues: FILE DATE MISMATCH: the filename begins '20240121' and the file sits in profiles/2024-2025/, but the chart header prints 21/01/2025 11:00, so the header date (2025-01-21, season 2024-25) is used and the JSON is filed under validation/observed/2024-25/ rather than 2023-24. It is NOT the same pit as 'Takakkaw Falls Full -21-Jan.jpg' (21/01/2024, 1780 m, air -3 C, different layers). Hardness bars, boundaries and temperature dots measured from native pixels (HS line at y=157, ground at y=751 give 5.17 px/cm; hardness ticks every 24 px = 1/3 step); boundaries rounded to integer cm. The temperature axis on this chart is rescaled (-16..0 C with labels every 2 C, 25.5 px per C, 0 at x=447), so temperature values use that scale; there is no dot at 10 cm; the top dot (surface, -14.5 C) equals the header air temperature. A red line drawn across the hardness chart at 107 cm marks the CT3 PC test height. Glyph readings: two linked circles read as MFcr; open square as FC; square-with-rounded-top as FCxr; '⟋(+)' as DF with secondary PP. The top-row surface form has size 1 but no glyph, so surface_grain is null. Aspect field is blank; 'flat' is assumed from the 0 deg slope. The CT3 PC failure is at the top of the 105-107 cm crust, which the layer note flags as the problematic layer (layer_grain MFcr).
